title: List Discovery Configs
description: Lists discovery configurations for a given project and location.

objective.narrative: This sample demonstrates how to retrieve a list of data discovery configurations, which are used to scan and profile storage resources. Each configuration defines what data to scan and how often to update the data profiles.
